description.zh:
ECS实例vCPU核数。

>同时指定`Cores`参数和`Memory`参数会匹配所有满足vCPU核数和内存大小的实例规格。
description.en:
The number of vCPUs of the ECS instance.

>If you specify both the Cores and Memory parameters, the system matches all instance types that meet the specified vCPU and memory requirements.

description.zh:
ECS实例的计费方式。更多详情，请参见[计费概述](~~25398~~)。取值范围：

- PrePaid：包年包月
- PostPaid：按量付费

默认值：PostPaid
description.en:
The billing method of the ECS instance. For details, see [Billing overview](~~25398~~). Valid values:

- PrePaid: subscription.
- PostPaid: pay-as-you-go.

Default value: PostPaid.

description.zh:
实例规格族级别。取值范围：

- EntryLevel：入门级。
- EnterpriseLevel：企业级。
- CreditEntryLevel：积分入门级。详情请参见[突发性能实例](~~59977~~)。
description.en:
The level of the instance family. Valid values:

- EntryLevel: entry level.
- EnterpriseLevel: enterprise level.
- CreditEntryLevel: credit-based entry level. For details, see [Burstable instances](~~59977~~).

description.zh:
指定的实例规格。更多详情，请参见[实例规格族](~~25378~~)，也可以调用[DescribeInstanceTypes](~~25620~~)接口获得最新的规格表。

> 如果您指定了`InstanceType`，则无法指定`Cores`或者`Memory`。
description.en:
The specified instance type. For details, see [Instance families](~~25378~~). You can also call the [DescribeInstanceTypes](~~25620~~) operation to query the most recent instance type list.

> If you specify InstanceType, you cannot specify Cores or Memory.

description.zh: 设置备选的实例规格族集合，备选的实例规格会从该参数设置的实例规格族中选择。最多可输入10个实例规格族。
description.en: Settings for the collection of alternative instance families from which alternative instance types are selected. You can specify up to 10 instance families.

description.zh:
是否为I/O优化实例。实例规格只支持非I/O优化时，不能设置IoOptimized参数。取值范围：

- optimized：I/O优化
- none：非IO优化

默认值：optimized

如果您设置的是已停售实例规格。默认值：none
description.en:
Specifies whether the instance is I/O optimized. If the instance type supports only non-I/O optimized instances, you cannot set the IoOptimized parameter. Valid values:

- optimized: I/O optimized.
- none: non-I/O optimized.

Default value: optimized.

If you specify a retired instance type, the default value is none.

description.zh:
按量付费实例或者抢占式实例可接受的每小时最高价格。

>设置抢占式实例的最高单价时，`SpotStrategy`必须设置为`SpotWithPriceLimit`。
description.en:
The maximum acceptable hourly price for pay-as-you-go or spot instances.

>To set the maximum hourly price for a spot instance, set SpotStrategy to SpotWithPriceLimit.

description.zh:
ECS实例内存大小，单位为GiB。

>同时指定`Cores`参数和`Memory`参数会匹配所有满足vCPU核数和内存大小的实例规格。
description.en:
The memory size of the ECS instance. Unit: GiB.

>If you specify both the Cores and Memory parameters, the system matches all instance types that meet the specified vCPU and memory requirements.

description.zh:
ECS实例的网络类型。取值范围：

- vpc：专有网络VPC。
- classic：经典网络。经典网络功能已下线，详情请参见[下线公告](~~2833134~~)。

默认值：vpc
description.en:
The network type of the ECS instance. Valid values:

- vpc: virtual private cloud (VPC).
- classic: classic network. The classic network is no longer available. For more information, see [Discontinuation notice](~~2833134~~).

Default value: vpc.

description.zh:
优先推荐策略。取值范围：

- InventoryFirst：库存优先。
- PriceFirst：价格优先，按每小时vCPU单价从低到高排序。
- NewProductFirst：最新产品优先。

默认值：InventoryFirst
description.en:
The priority-based recommendation strategy. Valid values:

- InventoryFirst: inventory first.
- PriceFirst: price first. Instance types are sorted by the hourly vCPU unit price in ascending order.
- NewProductFirst: newest product first.

Default value: InventoryFirst.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
在哪种场景下推荐实例规格。取值范围：

- UPGRADE：升级或降低实例规格。
- CREATE：创建实例。

默认值：CREATE
description.en:
The scenario in which instance types are recommended. Valid values:

- UPGRADE: upgrade or downgrade an instance type.
- CREATE: create an instance.

Default value: CREATE.

description.zh:
抢占式实例的竞价策略。取值范围：

- NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，最高按量付费价格。

> 使用`SpotStrategy`时，`InstanceChargerType`必须设置为`PostPaid`。

默认值：NoSpot
description.en:
The bidding policy for the spot instance. Valid values:

- NoSpot: a pay-as-you-go instance.
- SpotWithPriceLimit: a spot instance with a maximum hourly price.
- SpotAsPriceGo: a spot instance for which the system automatically bids at up to the pay-as-you-go price.

> When you use SpotStrategy, set InstanceChargerType to PostPaid.

Default value: NoSpot.

description.zh:
系统盘的云盘种类。取值范围：

- cloud_efficiency：高效云盘
- cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
- cloud_essd：ESSD云盘
- cloud：普通云盘

非I/O优化实例的默认值：cloud

I/O优化实例的默认值：cloud_efficiency
description.en:
The category of the system disk. Valid values:

- cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
- cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
- cloud_essd: enterprise SSD (ESSD).
- cloud: basic disk.

Default value for non-I/O optimized instances: cloud.

Default value for I/O optimized instances: cloud_efficiency.

description.zh:
可用区ID。您可以调用[DescribeZones](~~25610~~)查看最新的阿里云可用区列表。

建议同时ZoneMatchMode取值为Include（默认值），优先推荐ZoneId指定的可用区中的实例规格，并列出同地域下其他可用区中的实例规格。
description.en:
The zone ID. You can call [DescribeZones](~~25610~~) to query the most recent zone list.

Set ZoneMatchMode to Include (default value) to preferentially recommend instance types in the zone specified by ZoneId and also list instance types in other zones within the same region.

description.zh:
是否仅推荐ZoneId指定的可用区中的实例规格。取值范围：

- Strict：仅推荐ZoneId指定的可用区中的实例规格。

- Include：推荐同地域下其他可用区中的实例规格。


当指定`ZoneId`时，该参数的默认值为Strict，表示仅推荐ZoneId指定的可用区中的实例规格。
description.en:
Specifies whether to recommend only instance types in the zone specified by ZoneId. Valid values:

- Strict: recommends only instance types in the zone specified by ZoneId.

- Include: recommends instance types in other zones within the same region.


When ZoneId is specified, the default value of this parameter is Strict, which indicates that only instance types in the zone specified by ZoneId are recommended.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-recommend-instance-type --cores 2 --memory 8.0 --instance-family-level EnterpriseLevel --instance-type ecs.hfg6.large --network-type vpc --instance-charge-type PostPaid --spot-strategy NoSpot --io-optimized optimized --priority-strategy PriceFirst --max-price 10.0 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-f --system-disk-category cloud_ssd --zone-match-mode Strict --scene CREATE --instance-type-family ecs.hfg6 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribeRecommendInstanceType --region cn-hangzhou --ZoneMatchMode Strict --IoOptimized optimized --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-f' --Memory '8.0' --InstanceChargeType PostPaid --Scene CREATE --SystemDiskCategory cloud_ssd --Cores 2 --PriorityStrategy PriceFirst --NetworkType vpc --InstanceTypeFamily.1 'ecs.hfg6' --InstanceFamilyLevel EnterpriseLevel --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceType 'ecs.hfg6.large' --MaxPrice '10.0' --SpotStrategy NoSpot
